Experience

ByteDance — AI Application Intern, Foundation Platform (Data Architecture)　May 2026 – Jul 2026

  • Built a standardized delivery pipeline for an AI coding assistant (interface changes, PPE test deployment, BAM/IDL release, MCP Server updates, code review); automated completion rose from ~50% to over 80% on tested tasks.
  • Tagged MCP-created assets (workflows, operators, data sources, profiles) with provenance spanning synchronous creation, asynchronous BPM callbacks and legacy assets; unified growth metrics to evaluate tooling impact.
  • Aggregated model-usage events into Redis in 10s windows and surfaced per-key TPM with feature switches and graceful JWT-failure degradation, so monitoring never blocks the main flow.

MiniMax — Compute Platform Intern (AI Infra)　Oct 2025

  • Optimized the KV Cache implementation and proposed a transpose-free tensor-parallel partitioning scheme, improving inference throughput.
  • Embedded CUDA XXHash into the KV Cache copy path, trading ~10% runtime for system robustness and eliminating silent failures caused by memory overflow.

Research

Zhejiang University — State Key Laboratory of CAD&CG — Research Intern　Oct 2024 – Apr 2025

  • Co-developed a low-cost micro-surface reconstruction method for traditional Chinese painting: with a monitor as the gradient-illumination source, six images reconstruct the surface normal map and mesh at 0.1–0.3mm; BRISQUE, NIQE and PIQE beat the photometric-stereo SOTA SDM-UniPS, at ~4s and 2.2GB GPU memory.
  • Owned multi-view registration and fusion (SIFT + RANSAC, 0.85 matching success rate) onto the normal map, overcoming the camera-resolution limit on microscopic detail; also cut mesh size by 90% via edge-collapse ordering with a quadric error metric (QEM).
  • Publication: DanqingScan: Low-cost 3D scanning for traditional Chinese painting analysis, Visual Informatics (JCR Q1), 2026 — 4th author. DOI: 10.1016/j.visinf.2026.100353
  • Google Scholar: Mingyang Xu — Citations
